en.overview: Fast-flowing mountain streams and wider lowland rivers that support aquatic insects, fish, and riparian vegetation along rocky or gravelly banks.
what_to_look_for: Clear, well-oxygenated water with visible riffles and pools
Aquatic insect larvae (caddisflies, mayflies) clinging to submerged stones
Riparian birds like brown dippers (Kawagarasu) or wagtails
Natural gravel bars and overhanging streamside trees
confirm_more: Wide shot from the bank showing water flow and riverbed structure
Close-up of submerged stones or gravel to show algae and sediment
Eye-level view of the riverbank vegetation and natural erosion
management_signs: Concrete embankments, tetrapods, or check dams (sabo)
Weirs or water intake structures altering natural flow
Litter or muddy runoff from nearby roads or construction
en.seasonal_note: Spring snowmelt and summer typhoons dramatically reshape gravel bars and water levels.

ja.overview: 水生昆虫や魚類が生息し、岩や砂利の河岸に沿って水辺の植物が茂る、流れの速い渓流や幅の広い平地河川。
what_to_look_for: 瀬や淵が見られる、透明度が高く酸素が豊富な水流
水中の石に張り付く水生昆虫の幼虫（トビケラ、カゲロウなど）
カワガラスやセキレイ類などの水辺の鳥
自然の砂礫堆（河原）や川岸に張り出した樹木
confirm_more: 川の流れや河床の構造がわかる岸からの広角写真
藻類や堆積物の様子がわかる水中の石や砂利の接写
川岸の植生や自然な浸食の様子がわかる目線の高さの風景
management_signs: コンクリート護岸、テトラポッド、砂防ダム
自然な流れを変化させる堰や取水施設
ゴミの投棄や、近隣の道路・工事現場からの泥水の流出
ja.seasonal_note: 春の雪解けや夏の台風により、河原の形状や水位が劇的に変化します。
